Anbukku Naan Adimai Tamil Movie Songs HD, Kaaththodu Poovurasa Video Song featuring Rajinikanth and Rati Agnihotri on Mango Music Tamil. Music by Ilayaraja, directed by R. Thyagarajan and produced by C. Dandayuthapani.
Song: Kaaththodu Poovurasa
Singer: P. Susheela, SPB
Lyrics: Vaali
Anbukku Naan Adimai movie also stars Vijayan, Sujatha, Thengai Srinivasan, Surulirajan and Jayamalini among others.
